name: sensor_visual_alignment
description: Near an opening, measure projected center offset and axis-angle mismatch; track up to three later SAME-camera observation frames to check whether a correction improved them. Select two visible center/axis landmarks per object once on the anchor, using ORIGINAL image pixels. Local patch tracking (24px search) reports unknown on weak/ambiguous evidence; re-anchor after large motion or occlusion. Returns compact pixel/degree measurements, not base-frame motion or insertion success. No localize_target dependency. If tracking is lost, inspect the current image and pass reselected_axes for that step, or start a new anchor. Do not reuse hidden centers.

feature_axis_px.description: On anchor image: [[visible insertion-tip center x,y],[point along its long axis x,y]]. At least 8 pixels apart.

reference_axis_px.description: On SAME anchor image: [[visible opening center x,y],[point along its long axis x,y]]. At least 8 pixels apart. Select actual visible features, not an adjacent surface point.

reselected_axes.description: Optional current-frame re-selection after tracking loss/occlusion. Measurements are marked caller-selected, not automatically tracked. Use only steps in compare_steps.

feature_axis_px.description: On this entry's current step image: feature center and axis point, at least 8 pixels apart.

reference_axis_px.description: On this entry's SAME current step image: visible opening center and axis point, at least 8 pixels apart. Do not infer a hidden center.
